answer_1.quote: We leverage the ASAP dataset and provide the LLM with the essay prompt to generate machine‑written essays ...
answer_1.outputs: AI-generated student essays (both unperturbed and perturbed versions)

answer_2.quote: We report the detection accuracy of both the AI‑generated and the human‑written essays to evaluate the performance of the detector ... we also incorporate the AES score as an additional criterion to evaluate the quality of the generated essays.

answer_3.quote: The recent RoBERTa‑QA and RoBERTa‑Single models trained on the HC3 dataset serve as state‑of‑the‑art detectors ... we fine‑tune the RoBERTa detectors to better identify machine‑generated content.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation tests by presenting two annotators (master candidates in computer science) with 162 sets of essay pairs ... recording their pairwise preferences.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose the preferred essay in each pair without being told which essay was AI‑generated.
